subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should accepted, uncertain Gateway disconnects reattach and recover the original run before the CLI uses its existing automatic isolated embedded fallback?
rationale: The implementation changes the user-visible disconnect policy rather than only repairing an established invariant, and the canonical product-direction issue remains open without a recorded maintainer choice.

options.title: Sponsor reattach-first recovery
options.body: Accept Gateway-owned recovery before fallback, contingent on current-head proof of both successful replay and automatic fallback after recovery exhaustion.

options.title: Keep immediate fallback policy
options.body: Retain the existing automatic isolated fallback as the first response to uncertain disconnects and pause this protocol expansion.

options.title: Adopt a narrower mode split
options.body: Choose a scoped policy such as reattach-first only for delivery-oriented runs if maintainers want to preserve interactive fallback latency.

recommendation.title: Sponsor reattach-first recovery
recommendation.body: Accept Gateway-owned recovery before fallback, contingent on current-head proof of both successful replay and automatic fallback after recovery exhaustion.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current-main fallback containment behavior and are best positioned to decide whether its recovery sequencing should change.
